subject.title: fix: stop doctor misreporting trusted-proxy gateways as unauthenticated

question: Should a non-loopback Gateway with a runtime-valid, host-scoped trusted-proxy configuration be reported by Doctor as a warning with firewall guidance rather than as an unauthenticated critical finding?
rationale: The implementation deliberately changes a security diagnostic’s severity and remediation for an externally reachable Gateway; code review can establish the runtime alignment, but it cannot choose the repository’s intended operator-facing security posture.

options.title: Approve the trusted-proxy warning policy
options.body: Accept the runtime-aligned warning and firewall guidance for fully valid trusted-proxy deployments while retaining critical findings for invalid, unsafe, or unverifiable configurations.

options.title: Retain a critical exposure finding
options.body: Require Doctor to keep an elevated critical finding for every non-loopback trusted-proxy Gateway even when the authentication configuration is runtime-valid.

recommendation.title: Approve the trusted-proxy warning policy
recommendation.body: Accept the runtime-aligned warning and firewall guidance for fully valid trusted-proxy deployments while retaining critical findings for invalid, unsafe, or unverifiable configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review history points to this person for the unresolved Gateway security-policy decision.
